item.title: Missed Opportunity: Critical Minerals and the U.S.-Vietnam Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
item.description: Whether the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership fulfills its early promise will depend on whether Washington and Hanoi can move past current frictions and convert shared strategic interests into concrete, resilient cooperation.

item.title: States Weekly: August 26, 2026
item.description: This edition of States Weekly covers August 26, 2026.

item.title: Human Rights Initiative Director's Note: August 2026 Edition
item.description: The August 2026 edition of the Human Rights Initiative Director's Note where Andrew Friedman shares his reflections on human rights and democracy issues occupying significant space in his mind, highlights key HRI ongoings, and spotlights notable articles and videos he's come across.

item.title: From the Petrodollar to the Tokendollar: Economic Statecraft in the AI Era
item.description: AI tokens are emerging as the currency of a new international order. Benjamin Jensen argues that the United States should create a “tokendollar” linking AI infrastructure, futures markets, and dollar-backed stablecoins to extend U.S. financial power into the AI era.

item.title: How Quickly Can the DOD Rebuild and Recast the Munitions Industrial Base?
item.description: The U.S. munitions industrial base should be rebuilt and recast for modern wars of precision and attrition. What is a realistic timeline for this goal? By analyzing DOD budget documents and industry announcements, this analysis provides a clearer picture of the planned future.

item.title: The Europe Force Posture Review and the Transition to NATO 3.0
item.description: The Europe Force Posture Review marks a pivotal moment in NATO's evolution. The ultimate challenge is whether European allies can close critical capability gaps during the transition while preserving the cohesion that underpins collective defense.

item.title: Out of Bounds: What the U.S. Government Should Do in Response to AI Agent Containment Failures
item.description: The OpenAI-Hugging Face cyber incident exposes deep flaws both in the current cybersecurity practices of frontier labs and in the regulatory structures that oversee AI. In a new commentary, Aalok Mehta explains what happened and how policymakers should respond.

item.title: What’s Behind China’s Problematic Advance in Uruguay?
item.description: CSIS Americas Program Senior Associate Evan Ellis assesses China’s growing influence in Uruguay, its broader geopolitical implications, and what the United States should do in response.

item.title: The Iran War at Six Months: Energy, Markets, and National Security
item.description: CSIS scholars and guests discuss how markets and policy have adjusted to the closure and intermittent reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and energy infrastructure as a target in modern warfare.

item.title: AI and Global Food Security: A Focus on Food Systems
item.description: As food systems face increasingly severe and complex shocks, AI-enabled innovations are proliferating across food production, logistics, markets, and humanitarian response. CSIS experts unpack the challenges and opportunities of AI for global food systems.
